summary.text: Gordon Heslop, a Republican retired accounting educator from Natchitoches, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Louisiana's 4th Congressional District to Mike Johnson.
He also ran for U.S. House seats in Texas and Missouri in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Heslop earned graduate degrees from Mississippi State University and the University of Southern Mississippi, and also attended the University of Auckland and the University of Otago.

He says he taught accounting at the university level for more than 30 years, most recently at Northwestern State University of Louisiana and East Texas A&M University (formerly Texas A&M University-Commerce), and is now retired.
He lost the Republican primary for Texas' 32nd Congressional District on March 3, 2026, and the Republican primary for Missouri's 8th Congressional District on August 4, 2026.
His campaign theme was "Make America Normal Again," with a focus on the middle class, the national debt and education.
He received 1.1% of the vote to Mike Johnson's 58.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
Heslop says he has been a Republican for 44 years and is married with adult children.
